stories.headline: He Blew the Whistle on DOGE. Then His Brakes Were Cut
stories.dek: A federal IT staffer filed a complaint about DOGE, then went public. Shortly after Elon Musk boosted a post calling his claims false, his brake lines were cut. Now he’s suing for defamation.

stories.headline: Google rolls out fake call detection to protect against AI deepfake impersonation scams
stories.dek: As people increasingly refuse to answer calls from unknown numbers, scammers are shifting their tactics by spoofing trusted phone numbers and using AI deepfake technology to sound like authority figures, family members, or employers.

stories.headline: Android Is Fighting Phone Scams With a New Feature to Prove Who’s Calling
stories.dek: Available for Android 12 and later, the anti-scam feature is baked into Google Dialer, which sends a silent “confirmation signal” to ensure whoever’s calling you is who they appear to be.

stories.headline: Flush With Cash From OpenAI, Opal Is Making an AI-Powered Audio Gadget
stories.dek: Opal, the company famous for making a fancy webcam, has pivoted to making other consumer electronics. Fueled by big investments from OpenAI and Samsung, it’s working on an audio gadget first.

stories.headline: A Viral YouTube Show About an Unhinged AI Is Hitting Theaters. It’s a Big Test for Hollywood
